consequence.statement: New alpha render subcommands are available for XRs and Operations; this is additional functionality with no mandatory operational changes.

original.statement: Alpha render subcommands for XRs and Operations were added to the Crossplane CLI.

decision.reason: [ev-b786521a5451] describes only an addition: new alpha render subcommands for XRs and Operations. It says nothing that fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated. An environment that does nothing just doesn't use the new subcommands, so the consequence kind "none" (informational) fits the evidence and no mandatory work is claimed.
